subject: How to determine tip order with ladderize when there are ties?

messages.author: bbd4b13b3cf07e14
messages.subject: How to determine tip order with ladderize when there are ties?
parts: Whee using ggtree to plot a ladderized tree using right=TRUE, how does ggtree determine the order when sister clades have the same number of tips? I would like to be able to specify that where there are ties, some feature of the tip labels (e.g. the clade containing the alphabetically first label) be used to resolve the order.

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: How to determine tip order with ladderize when there are ties?
parts: please see the source code of ape::ladderize.
